title: Altair plots can't be exported to vega editors
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

Altair charts normally are exportable to vega lite (by clicking in the context menu). 
This allows adjusting plots (e.g. by removing some point or adjusting colors / sizes / names in legend) for presentation purposes.

Below I give an example how it works in altair documentation, and how it doesn't work in streamlit.

### Reproducible Code Example

_No response_

### Steps To Reproduce

1. open streamlit documentation https://docs.streamlit.io/library/api-reference/charts/st.altair_chart
2. scroll to first altair plot, in the context menu select "Open in vega editor"
3. try to RUN - you'll see empty plot because exported json does not contain any data

### Expected Behavior

1. open altair's documentation https://altair-viz.github.io/gallery/simple_bar_chart.html
2. in the context menu select "Open in vega editor"
3. click RUN - and you see the plot. Note that source json on the left contains the dataset.

### Current Behavior

_No response_

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.25.0 (latest)
- Python version: 3.10
- Operating System: mac
- Browser: chrome and firefox - both affected


### Additional Information

_No response_
